messages:
alex: quick heads-up: i'm prototyping a change to the cost dashboard sampling to improve visibility into low-volume / high-cost SKUs. currently we do flat 1/100 sampling and it erases heavy-tail invocations.
jess: yup we keep seeing noisy per-sku p95s because of that. what's the idea?
alex: stratified sampling. baseline stays 1/100, but increase sampling probability for (a) requests with expected_tokens>1024 hints and (b) requests where observed latency_bucket is high. goal: keep ingestion steady but surface rare expensive calls.
matt: implement where? router has cheap hooks but no token_count after response, collector sees full record but is less flexible for per-sku budgets.
daria: i'd do hybrid: router tags candidates when client hint exists; collector uses post-hoc latency predicate to upsample missed ones. collector emits sample_weight so aggregators can reweight.
zoe: alert: changing sampling will change reported per-route costs. product teams will panic if numbers jump. we need a migration view showing old vs new estimates and a banner explaining the change.
alex: agreed. rollout plan: feature flag behind canary; expose paired views (legacy-weighted vs stratified-estimate) for 72h then flip default. add migration banner with diff sparkline.
jess: also think about cache-savings attribution. currently cache-prefetch tokens are attributed to caller SKU but actually shared. if we upsample tails that are mostly cold, we might under-report amortized cache savings.
matt: good point. compute cache-savings at session-level and then apportion to invocations by weighted token share. aggregator should accept session_cache_savings and distribute based on per-invocation weight.
daria: quick sketch:
```
# router (pre-response): tag hint
if hint.expected_tokens and hint.expected_tokens>1024:
    mark.upworthy = True
# collector (post-response): compute sample_weight
sample_weight = 1
if record.mark.upworthy: sample_weight *= 10
if record.latency_ms > 200: sample_weight *= 5
emit(record with sample_weight, cache_hits, model_sku, route_id)
# aggregator: use weighted sums
model_cost = sum(sample_weight * observed_cost) / sum(sample_weight)
```
zoe: quotas: sampling must not affect enforcement. quota subsystem uses raw counts. dashboards use weighted estimates only. also add /internal/sampling/debug endpoint so SRE can replay why an invocation was upsampled.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/stratified-sampler -> canary eng-platform @ 2024-11-08T09:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:
alex: next actions: i'll open RFC + PR for router flag and collector field. matt will prototype the migration UI with side-by-side series and a sampling-impact sparkline. jess/daria review attribution math. zoe will coordinate comms with product & CS.
matt: i'll mock the UI. default show legacy series for 48h then toggle. include absolute and percent delta annotations.
jess: also request: make sampling config queryable via internal API for reproduction. add a cheap debug endpoint /internal/sampling/debug?invocation_id=... returning sample_weight breakdown.
daria: ack. small perf hit but gated to debug queries. we'll ensure no PII leaks.
zoe: timeline: if canary passes, 50% in 24h, full in 72h. push comms before any default flips.
alex: sounds good. tagging @matt @jess @daria @zoe. i'll draft the migration note and PR today. :rocket:
